question: In a class, there are four students - Ravindra, Shiva, Triveni and Nagesh, who want to be selected in the basketball team. All of them have different heights. Nagesh is shorter than Ravindra but taller than Triveni. Shiva is shorter than Nagesh but taller than Triveni. If the coach wants to select the tallest student among them, then who will be selected?
solution:

1. Nagesh is shorter than Ravindra but taller than Triveni. 

Ravindra > Nagesh > Triveni
